mechanism: All non-overlapping repair subsets of slot repairs → multiple paths can apply to same surface spans
Each retained domain bucket calls buildSentenceCandidates independently; identical text can appear in multiple buckets
Different SegmentationPaths may produce identical sentence text
Different repair picks yield sentences differing by 1–2 chars; exact-text dedup does NOT remove them
Gap canonical picks differ by path but final text may still collide after apply
KenLM does not generate or dedupe candidates
